messages:
sam: thanks for staying a bit after the all-hands Q&A — leadership asked for a compact synthesis of why we're winning/losing and concrete asks we can act on. drop 1-line confirmations + owners pls.

mira: Sales quick take: wins = clear perf metrics + compact pilot programs that prove ops. losses = procurement wants per-feature capped spend and clearer cost predictability; also some competitors win on contracts with embedded professional services.

alex: CS + field: agree. additional loss signal: supervised evals showing hallucination on niche legal/financial prompts — customers want an automatic rerank + deterministic fallback chain (main -> reranker -> small-verified model). Also asks for a partner enablement pack.

devin: Eng notes: runtime KV cache + adaptive batching landing next release which should visibly tighten p99/p95 for long sessions. Also prototyping a graceful-degradation policy that routes to a smaller model on latency spikes. PRs queued under `runtime/gradual-fallback`.

natalie: from Product: top asks consolidated so far -> (1) private/VPC timeline (2) per-request token cost breakdown in Console (behind flag) (3) SLO packages + simple SLA language for sales playbooks (4) partner enablement docs. I'll sketch a one-pager.

hemant: Pricing/Finance: procurement asks for an 'apples-to-apples' unit economics table. they want to present token + throughput cost per feature to procurement. I'll work with Mira on a midmarket-friendly template.

rob: Marketing: want 2 short win blurbs where caching + ops runbook turned a pilot into a contract. I can sanitize and publish if CS provides quotes.

mira: I'll own the pricing template + midmarket playbook. ETA: first draft by Tue COB.

devin: I'll own the fallback policy prototype + perf SLO draft. ETA: bench runs + draft doc by next Wed.

alex: CS will produce top 8 asks + 3 sanitized loss postmortems with example prompts by EOW. tagging security/latency/hallucination as top signal buckets.

ci-bot: action created: TICKET-5101 "AH synthesis: wins/losses & playbook" assigned to natalie, mira, devin.

sam: quick operational asks: 1) owners add a 1-line customer-facing messaging statement to the ticket (for partners) 2) add ETA and blocker notes. can we do that by Mon EOD?

mira: yes. I'll add messaging + sample price scenarios.

devin: will include SLO tiers (basic/standard/enterprise) + a short benchmark appendix.

natalie: i'm scheduling a 30m sync with owners to align scope and delivery dates. will invite Mira/Devin/Alex.

alex: small feature ask from CS: expose model-variant token & latency breakdown for the last 30 days in Console (could help procurement and SE demos). sounds like a product + infra job.

devin: noted. will scope a `telemetry.token_cost_per_variant` flag for beta customers; include feasibility note in my draft.

rob: once we have owner drafts, marketing can assemble a one-pager + 2 slide partner summary.

sam: great. if no objections i'll close this thread — we'll track progress via TICKET-5101 and next leadership sync. thanks team. :thumbsup:
